defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: QuestVulkanRenderPipelineConfigurator callbackOrder is -4700; OnPreprocessBuild enforces Quest quality row, Android quality index, SPI, and Vulkan.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonUrpTextureRequirementsGuard.cs:104 returns before color force; HectonUnderwaterVisuals.cs:1267 returns before color/postprocess force.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Per-camera URP guard performed TryGetComponent from beginCameraRendering on every camera.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonUrpTextureRequirementsGuard uses a fixed 32-slot camera data cache. Cache-hit path lines 117-127 has no TryGetComponent.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Underwater biome fog blend scheduled a one-sample job using transient DataVault views without write-lock ownership.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonUnderwaterVisuals now applies a local struct-only visual fake in SlowTick: ApplyBiomeFogBlend lines 3623-3667 and ResolveBiomeFogAupBlend lines 3668-3694. BufferID.UnderwaterBiomeFog* references are absent from HectonUnderwaterVisuals.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Runtime ResolveMainCamera fallback searched transform.root for string child Main Camera.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: The runtime root.Find fallback was removed; runtime route now relies on cached player/camera owner paths and nearest parent camera fallback.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Foveated telemetry hot path still used a struct object-initializer with the token new.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: FoveatedRenderCommander.WriteTelemetry now builds FoveatedRenderTelemetryEntry with default plus field assignments at lines 957-980.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: FoveatedRenderCommander.TryAcquireTelemetryWriteBuffer released an acquired DataVault write lock on failed post-acquire validation outside a local finally block.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: FoveatedRenderCommander.cs:1199-1231 now uses releaseOnExit inside try/finally: successful validation transfers lock ownership to WriteTelemetry; failed validation releases in the local finally. QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:361-390 asserts both the failed-validation finally and the transferred-lock WriteTelemetry finally.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: FoveatedRenderCommander.ApplyPolicy called Quest2 classification and Quest-family string-token classification as separate routes. Generic Quest-family tokens could leave classification pending, so Android render policy could repeat SystemInfo/XRSettings string scans on later policy commits.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: FoveatedRenderCommander.cs:482-485 now calls one cached RefreshQuestRuntimeClass route. FoveatedRenderCommander.cs:1474-1500 caches Quest-family classification and completes generic Quest-family tokens as family=true, Quest2-lock=false. QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:294-299 asserts the cached route and forbids the old per-policy string-scan route.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Quest renderer kept third-party ShapesRenderFeature active even though first-party runtime code has no active Shapes immediate-mode owner. Vendor AddRenderPasses checks DrawCommand.cBuffersRendering and enqueues ObjectPool<ShapesRenderPass> passes per camera.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: Quest_VR_Renderer.asset sets ShapesRenderFeature m_Active: 0 at line 293; QuestVulkanRenderPipelineConfigurator strips Contains(name, "ShapesRenderFeature") at line 188; QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406 asserts the inactive block at line 119.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Quest renderer YAML had unnecessary renderer feature list/map order drift in the working tree, and FluidAdvectionRenderFeature still enqueued a pass when the cached fluid rendergraph owner was null.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: Quest_VR_Renderer.asset feature list and m_RendererFeatureMap were normalized to baseline order with 13/13 list-map matches; HectonFluidAdvectionRenderFeature.cs:128-130 returns before enqueue when _cachedFluidEngine is null, and lines 47 plus 136 reject overlay cameras before owner claim/setup.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: WristPdaScreenProjectorFeature.AddRenderPasses enqueued the PDA projector pass for Preview, Reflection, and SceneView cameras even though RecordRenderGraph later rejected those camera types.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: WristPdaScreenProjectorFeature.cs:193-198 now returns before _pass.Setup and renderer.EnqueuePass for non-game and overlay cameras; QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:194-212 asserts the guard order.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: WristPdaScreenProjectorFeature bound the PDA atlas with data.Material.SetTexture inside the RenderGraph render func, so the atlas texture was a hidden external dependency rather than a declared RenderGraph read.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: WristHologramHudRuntime_PdaScreenProjector.cs:235 and 700-750 cache an RTHandle for the atlas on the owner cold graphics-buffer setup path; TryGetActivePdaProjectionResources exposes that RTHandle at lines 1578-1604. WristPdaScreenProjectorFeature.cs:105 imports it, line 123 declares builder.UseTexture read access, and line 137 binds it through context.cmd.SetGlobalTexture.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonVRBrownoutFeature.AddRenderPasses did not mirror its RecordRenderGraph camera-type rejection, so Preview, Reflection, and SceneView cameras could reach comfort-state probing before the render graph rejected them.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonVRBrownoutFeature.cs:414-418 now returns before camera state build, _pass.Setup, and renderer.EnqueuePass for Preview, Reflection, SceneView, and overlay cameras; QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:215-225 asserts the order.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.AddRenderPasses could clear/setup/enqueue unified noir or stage raw-color reconstruction state for Preview, Reflection, and SceneView cameras before RecordRenderGraph rejected those camera types.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.cs:890-898 now returns before unified-pass setup, reconstruction staging, and renderer.EnqueuePass for Preview, Reflection, SceneView, and overlay cameras without clearing game-camera raw-history or pending reconstruction state; QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:231-247 asserts the order and forbids those clears inside the non-game and overlay guard windows.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.ResolveDepthlessTBDRPath could reach Quest/Vulkan device-model string classification from the per-frame depthless TBDR decision path.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.cs:810-811 stores cached platform classification; Create calls RefreshDepthlessTBDRPlatformCandidate at line 835; ResolveDepthlessTBDRPath lines 2504-2515 only reads cached booleans and XR active state. Static window proof: SystemInfo.deviceModel=false and IndexOf=false between ResolveDepthlessTBDRPath and RefreshDepthlessTBDRPlatformCandidate.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonDeferredCausticsFeature.AddRenderPasses could enqueue the deferred caustics pass even when AbyssalDeferredCausticsRuntime had not published a valid constant buffer; RecordRenderGraph rejected it later as a no-op.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonDeferredCausticsFeature.cs:167-170 now rejects overlay cameras before claiming the active constant buffer and checks AbyssalDeferredCausticsRuntime.TryGetActiveConstantBuffer before _pass.Setup and renderer.EnqueuePass; RecordRenderGraph lines 70-73 also reject overlay cameras before importing the constant buffer.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonAtmosphereSootFeature could enqueue active soot for the game camera after its GPU constants buffer became unavailable; RecordRenderGraph rejected it later after setup/state work.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonAtmosphereSootFeature.cs:102-105 exposes HasPreparedResources without allocation, and AddRenderPasses lines 424-427 now returns before runtime state build, setup, and enqueue for overlay cameras or unavailable GPU constants; QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:269-286 asserts the guard order.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonAtmosphereSootFeature consumed fixed soot radius/dither/darken values without the continuous HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight scaler required by the rendering pillar.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonAtmosphereSootFeature.cs:484-493 applies a continuous quality curve before RuntimeState publish; line 511 reads HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight. Low quality reduces soot radius/dither/darken pressure; high quality restores or slightly enriches the visual without changing gameplay truth or DTO layout.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Active Quest fullscreen/presentation features still accepted overlay camera stack entries after non-game camera rejection, so XR camera stacks could repeat Brownout, DeferredCaustics, AtmosphereSoot, and UberPost work on overlay cameras.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: Added CameraRenderType.Base guards before texture, constant-buffer, runtime-state, setup, or enqueue work: HectonVRBrownoutFeature.cs:126 and 417; HectonDeferredCausticsFeature.cs:70 and 167; HectonAtmosphereSootFeature.cs:124 and 424; HectonVisorUberPostFeature.cs:338 and 895. Static order checks report PASS for all eight guard-before-work routes.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: APEX zero-GC text audit still found `new RuntimeState(` tokens in active Quest fullscreen setup routes. These were value-type constructor calls, not managed allocations, but they weakened the required exact text proof.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonVRBrownoutFeature.cs:50 and HectonVisorUberPostFeature.cs:171 now use mutable private RuntimeState structs; HectonVRBrownoutFeature.cs:436-474 and HectonVisorUberPostFeature.cs:2254-2347 build state with `default` plus field assignments. QuestVrOptimizationValidator1406.cs:222-224 and 240-242 assert `runtimeState = default;`, forbid `new RuntimeState(`, and forbid `private readonly struct RuntimeState` for those active paths.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: Expanded visor-domain scan still found `new RuntimeState(` tokens in secondary/inactive visor renderer features: BIOS diagnostic, retina distortion, and visor fluid distortion.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonBiosDiagnosticFeature.cs:42,283-287; HectonRetinaDistortionFeature.cs:69,488-493; and HectonVisorFluidDistortionFeature.cs:124,1082-1100 now use `default` plus field assignments. `rg -n "new RuntimeState\(|private readonly struct RuntimeState" Assets/_Project/Scripts/Visor` returns no hits.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: AbyssalDeferredCausticsRuntime.LoadLightingProfilesCsv acquired csv scratch and profiles in one combined condition, then released the scratch handle in the failed branch. If the first acquire failed, that branch attempted release against an unacquired scratch handle; if the second acquire failed, scratch release was outside the established lock-flag/finally proof route.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: AbyssalDeferredCausticsRuntime.cs:367 acquires csv scratch alone, :372 sets scratchLocked only after success, :377 acquires profiles separately, :382 sets profilesLocked only after success, and :399-404 releases only locked buffers in finally.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.Noir.RecordRenderGraph relied on parent AddRenderPasses overlay filtering and lacked its own CameraRenderType.Base guard before activeColorTexture access.
defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.fix: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.Noir.cs:144 now returns unless cameraData.renderType is Base; source texture use is at :147, so the pass is fail-closed if invoked directly or by a future enqueue path.

defectsFoundAndFixedInReaudit.problem: HectonVisorUberPostFeature.RecordRenderGraph called BindStaticPostTextures, which mutated material texture state with hidden RenderGraph dependencies for crack, lens dirt, blue noise, and VR comfort mask textures.
